knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

## 1. Download and merge

```{r}
require(haven)
require(dplyr)
require(rio)

dir.create('data/raw', recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

files  <- c('DEMO','CFQ','SLQ','DPQ','BMX','DIQ','BPQ','SMQ','ALQ','PAQ')
cycles <- data.frame(year = c('2011','2013'), suffix = c('G','H'))

# function to get the data from the cdc website
read_nhanes <- function(file, year, suffix){
  fname <- paste0(file, '_', suffix, '.xpt')
  path  <- file.path('data/raw', fname)
  if(!file.exists(path)){
    url <- paste0('https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/', year,
                  '/DataFiles/', fname)
    download.file(url, path, mode = 'wb')
  }
  read_xpt(path)
}

# empty list for the two cycles of data (2011-2012 and 2013-2014)
nhanes <- vector('list', 2)

# merge the 2011-2012 and 2013-2014 datasets into one
for(i in 1:2){
  d <- lapply(files, read_nhanes, year = cycles$year[i], suffix = cycles$suffix[i])
  d <- Reduce(function(x, y) left_join(x, y, by = 'SEQN'), d)
  d$cycle <- paste0(cycles$year[i], '-', as.numeric(cycles$year[i]) + 1)
  nhanes[[i]] <- d
}

# making the list into a dataframe <3
nhanes <- bind_rows(nhanes)
```

## 2. Recode and select variables

```{r}
# 'refused' (7, 77) and 'dont know' (9, 99) are recoded to missing.
na_codes <- function(x, codes) ifelse(x %in% codes, NA, x)

phq_items <- paste0('DPQ0', 1:9, '0')
nhanes[, phq_items] <- lapply(nhanes[, phq_items], na_codes, codes = c(7, 9))

# a lot of the survey questions are yes/no responses so this helps recode them
yes_no <- function(x) ifelse(x == 1, 1, ifelse(x == 2, 0, NA))

cog <- nhanes |>
  filter(RIDAGEYR >= 60, !is.na(CFDCSR)) |>
  # changing the column names to actually make sense
  transmute(
    id = SEQN,
    delayed_recall = CFDCSR,
    sleep_hours = na_codes(SLD010H, c(77, 99)),
    trouble_sleeping = yes_no(SLQ050),
    sleep_disorder = yes_no(SLQ060),
    age = RIDAGEYR,
    gender = ifelse(RIAGENDR == 1, 'Male', 'Female'),
    race = recode(RIDRETH3, `1` = 'Mexican American', `2` = 'Other Hispanic', `3` = 'NH White', 
                  `4` = 'NH Black', `6` = 'NH Asian', `7` = 'Other/Multi'),
    education = na_codes(DMDEDUC2, c(7, 9)),
    poverty_ratio = INDFMPIR,
    depression = rowSums(across(all_of(phq_items))),
    bmi = BMXBMI,
    diabetes = ifelse(DIQ010 %in% c(1, 3), 1, ifelse(DIQ010 == 2, 0, NA)),
    high_bp = yes_no(BPQ020),
    smoker_ever = yes_no(SMQ020),
    alcohol_12plus = yes_no(ALQ101),
    vigorous_activity = yes_no(PAQ650),
    moderate_activity = yes_no(PAQ665),
    cycle = cycle
  )

dim(cog)
```

## 3. Save

```{r}
export(cog, 'data/nhanes_cognition.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```
